# Example dispatch without a name

Prose may name people: Nora writes the brief and Ava plans it. Dev dependencies stay pinned.

```
Project profile: .company/project.md
Company profile: PROFILE.md
Language: en
Task: T1
Goal: Write the brief and keep the dev dependencies pinned.
Output: .company/work/demo/01-product-manager.md
Follow aico:handoff.
```

A fenced block that is not a dispatch block may hold a Name line:

```
Name: demo
Stack: node
```
